gloss: mild case; minor illness; minor injury

definitions.gloss: mild case; minor illness; minor injury
definitions.explanation: A condition, illness, or injury that is not severe and does not require intensive treatment. The opposite of 重症.

examples.japanese: {幸|さいわ}い{軽症|けいしょう}で{済|す}んだ。
examples.english: Fortunately, it was only a minor injury.

examples.japanese: {感染者|かんせんしゃ}のほとんどは{軽症|けいしょう}だった。
examples.english: Most of the infected people had mild cases.

examples.japanese: {事故|じこ}で{三人|さんにん}が{病院|びょういん}に{運|はこ}ばれたが、いずれも{軽症|けいしょう}で{命|いのち}に{別状|べつじょう}はない。
examples.english: Three people were taken to the hospital after the accident, but all had minor injuries and their lives are not in danger.

notes:
Compound of {軽|けい} (light, mild) + {症|しょう} (symptom, illness). Antonym: {重症|じゅうしょう} (serious/critical condition).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {軽症|けいしょう}で{済|す}む (to get off with only minor injuries)
- {軽症|けいしょう}{患者|かんじゃ} (patient with a mild case)
- {軽症|けいしょう}{者|しゃ} (person with minor injuries/illness)

SEVERITY SCALE:
{軽症|けいしょう} (mild) → {中等症|ちゅうとうしょう} (moderate) → {重症|じゅうしょう} (severe) → {重篤|じゅうとく} (critical)

USAGE NOTE:
Commonly seen in news reports about accidents and disease outbreaks. Not to be confused with the homophone {継承|けいしょう} (succession, inheritance).
